test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(57, 41, 32)

(65, 49, 40)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **1st number - 16 = 2nd number.**

**2nd number - 9 = 3rd number.**

For, (57, 41, 32)

⇒ First to Second: 57 - 16 = 41.

⇒ Second to Third: 41 - 9 = 32.

For, (65, 49, 40)

⇒ First to Second: 65 - 16 = 49.

⇒ Second to Third: 49 - 9 = 40.

**Option 1) (59, 85, 74)**

⇒ First to Second: 59 - 16 = 43. (Given Second number is 85, 85 ≠ 43)

Here, logic not followed.

**Option 2) (72, 56, 47)**

⇒ First to Second: 72 - 16 = 56. (Matches)

⇒ Second to Third: 56 - 9 = 47. (Matches)

**Here, logic followed.**

**Option 3) (96, 80, 61)**

⇒ First to Second: 96 - 16 = 80. (Matches)

⇒ Second to Third: 80 - 9 = 71. (Given Third number is 61, 61 ≠ 71)

Here, logic not followed.

**Option 4) (51, 35, 16)**

⇒ First to Second: 51 - 16 = 35. (Matches)

⇒ Second to Third: 35 - 9 = 26. (Given Third number is 16, 16 ≠ 26)

Here, logic not followed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
